warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D180 Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Discovery Sport D180 has the Ingenium AJ200D (L663 generation):
Timing chain wear - Ingenium diesel engines share a well-documented timing chain pattern. We replace timing chains, guides and tensioners as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist consensus, l663.guide specialist buying guide, what-breaks.com. This applies to L663 Defenders only - not to classic Defender models
